title: CLF-C02 vs AZ-900 vs Cloud Digital Leader
subtitle: Which foundational cloud certification to take in 2026

pros: AWS has the largest pool of cloud job openings — the broadest bet.
Recognized everywhere: IT services firms, consulting, freelance, large enterprises.
A well-marked path to the SAA-C03 next, with a huge amount of free learning material.
A $100 exam — the cheapest entry ticket of the three.
cons: A purely conceptual multiple-choice exam — it proves no hands-on skill.
AWS is losing some ground to Azure in large enterprises.
Still ~40 hours of study for a 'fundamentals' exam.
certs.bestFor: You want a broad cloud career or plan to freelance — AWS remains the safest bet.

pros: Azure dominates large enterprises, banks and the public sector.
Natural fit with Microsoft 365, which is already everywhere in corporate IT.
An approachable exam — a direct stepping stone to the AZ-104 Administrator.
Instant internal recognition if your employer is a Microsoft shop.
cons: A fast-moving Azure ecosystem — services get renamed frequently.
Mostly valuable if your employer (or target employer) is already on Azure.
Like the CLF, it is conceptual — no proof of hands-on practice.
certs.bestFor: Your employer or target is a bank, a government agency or a large corporation — Azure rules there.

pros: Designed for non-technical profiles — business vocabulary and use cases.
GCP is strong in data / ML and among tech startups.
A good foundation for working with cloud teams without being an engineer.
An approachable exam, focused on decisions rather than configuration.
cons: GCP has a smaller market share — fewer job openings.
Not a direct technical stepping stone (unlike CLF → SAA).
Rarely treated as a 'technical résumé' cert by recruiters.
certs.bestFor: You work in a non-technical role (sales, pre-sales, project management) or you are targeting a data-driven company or GCP startup.

verdicts.profile: You are just starting out and don't know which cloud to pick.
verdicts.why: AWS has the most job openings and the largest talent market — it is the lowest-risk default bet.

verdicts.profile: You already work with Microsoft 365 or at a large corporation.
verdicts.why: Azure is everywhere in large enterprises and the public sector; your cert will be recognized internally right away.

verdicts.profile: Your role is sales, pre-sales or project management.
verdicts.why: Cloud Digital Leader is explicitly designed for non-technical profiles — business vocabulary and use cases.

verdicts.profile: You want to move quickly on to a technical Associate cert.
verdicts.why: CLF-C02 → SAA-C03 is the best-marked path, with the most free resources available.

tldr: AWS CLF by default, AZ-900 if your world runs on Microsoft, Google Cloud Digital Leader for business profiles.
